name: VPN
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Network Engineer

beginner.summary: For network and systems engineers, cloud engineers and support staff who can configure Linux hosts and IP routing but have not built VPNs. Covers how tunnels encapsulate traffic, the cryptography behind them, WireGuard, OpenVPN with Easy-RSA, IPsec with IKEv2 and strongSwan, tunnel and transport mode, remote access with EAP, split tunnelling and split DNS, NAT traversal, MTU and MSS clamping, gateway firewall rules, a first Tailscale mesh, packet captures and a structured method for tunnels that will not come up, ending with a branch office and remote worker capstone.
prerequisites: Configures IPv4 addresses, subnets and static routes and explains what a default gateway does
Works in a Linux shell with sudo, systemctl, journalctl and a text editor such as vim or nano
Has two or more Linux VMs (for example Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12) that can reach each other, with root access and permission to install packages
outcomes: Build and verify WireGuard, OpenVPN and strongSwan IKEv2 tunnels between Linux hosts
Choose between site-to-site and remote access, tunnel and transport mode, and full and split tunnelling for a stated requirement
Fix the common causes of broken tunnels: proposal and key mismatches, blocked ports, NAT, MTU and missing routes
Capture and read VPN traffic with tcpdump and Wireshark to prove what is and is not encrypted
